name: footer-inverted-contact
title: Inverted contact footer
description: A dark footer led by one large email address, with the studio's details, profiles, sitemap and its local time beside them.
docs: Pass email (the large link; a long one breaks after the @), headline, address (lines), social, links (the sitemap) and legal. city with timeZone ('Europe/Amsterdam') adds the local-time line, and locale 'en-GB' writes it as 14:32. The clock renders after mount and is rewritten every minute; it is a time element with an accessible name, not a live region. A time zone the browser does not know shows the city without a clock, never a guessed time. The colours are primary and primary-foreground, so the footer is inverted in light and in dark. labels translate the fixed words. linkAs renders the sitemap links with your router's Link.
